_readme: Plans + mock-checkout seed. Ids + machine enums + numbers ONLY — no display prose (every label renders through t() from l10n/app_<locale>.arb, so the three locale seeds are structurally identical and parity is trivial; hrefs are computed in the facade, never seeded, the same split scaffold_facade uses). The checkout outcomes mirror kit/payments one-for-one: succeed/decline/cancel/timeout are the SeedPaymentsProvider profiles (SeedSucceed/SeedDecline/SeedCancel/SeedTimeout, kit/payments/lib/src/providers/seed/seed_payments_provider.dart) and error is the plain PaymentError branch — SeedTimeout itself RESOLVES to PaymentError('Seed payment timed out'), which is why the design shows five states over the kit's four PaymentResult cases. See generate.mjs.
